summary: Heavy cookware sits near counter edges accessible to children or pets.

hazards.title: Unsecured Heavy Pot Near Edge
hazards.detail: Heavy cast iron pot near island edge could be pulled down by small children.
fixSteps: Push cookware toward the center of the kitchen island.
Store heavy cast-iron pots in lower secured cabinets.

hazards.title: Loose Cookware Lid Near Edge
hazards.detail: Heavy lid placed loosely at the counter edge is easily knocked or pulled down.
fixSteps: Place lid securely onto its pot or in designated storage.
Keep heavy loose items away from outer countertop perimeter.

hazards.title: Accessible Hot Pot Hazard
hazards.detail: Large pot sitting on towel may contain hot food within reaching distance.
fixSteps: Keep cooling or hot foods pushed far back from counter edges.
Do not leave attractive food unattended around climbing pets.
